conclusion.reason: the text base inherits CC-BY-NC-4.0 from its training data, and that restriction passes to every derivative including fine-tuned ones

assets.name: text_base
assets.note: the MIT licence on MiniMind's code repository does not apply: weights inherit the licence of the data, not of the code that trained them

assets.name: minimind_o_data
assets.note: upstream sources include VoiceAssistant-400K and UltraChat-300K-SLAM-Omni; each carries its own terms and neither has been read

open_questions: the training data's licence is unstated upstream; the audio corpora it draws from have not been read
three frozen components ship in the runtime with unread terms
how_to_change_the_conclusion: replace the text base's training data with a corpus whose licence permits commercial use, and read the terms of the frozen components; loosening the statement without doing that would be a false claim
